variants.title: Weak localisation in a dirty film, coherence length 0.5 um at 1 K (simulated)
variants.sample: Thin metal film, L_phi(1 K) = 0.5 um (simulated, illustrative)
variants.note: A dirtier film dephases sooner, so B_phi is four times larger.

source.title: S. Hikami, A. I. Larkin and Y. Nagaoka, Prog. Theor. Phys. 63, 707 (1980)

variants.title: Weak localisation in a clean film, coherence length 2 um at 1 K (simulated)
variants.sample: Thin metal film, L_phi(1 K) = 2 um (simulated, illustrative)
variants.note: A cleaner film keeps its phase longer: the curve rises at a much smaller field.

source.title: S. Hikami, A. I. Larkin and Y. Nagaoka, Prog. Theor. Phys. 63, 707 (1980)

variants.title: Weak localisation with electron-phonon dephasing, L_phi ~ T^-1 (simulated)
variants.method: magnetoconductance, HLN fit at several temperatures
variants.unknown: phase coherence length and its temperature law
variants.note: Electron-phonon dephasing gives L_phi ~ T^(-p/2) with p = 2 to 4; here p = 2, so warming from 2 K to 8 K shortens L_phi four times.

source.title: S. Hikami, A. I. Larkin and Y. Nagaoka, Prog. Theor. Phys. 63, 707 (1980)
